summary: News Corporation filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing routine daily ASX reporting tied to its existing $1 billion stock repurchase program covering Class A and Class B common stock. The filing attaches Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2, the information furnished to the Australian Securities Exchange on the dates noted therein, satisfying ASX daily buy-back disclosure rules. No new authorization, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated; this is an ongoing open-market repurchase program. The risk-arb angle is minimal: watch cumulative repurchase pace, which can support the share price and signals management's capital-return posture.
